name: Grand Marnier / Strawberry Shortcake Sundae
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: The strawberry compote contains hundreds of tiny strawberry achenes (seeds) and is often macerated with orange liqueur/citrus.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Skip the macerated strawberry compote and ask for plain vanilla ice cream with warm shortcake biscuit only.
watchOuts: Possible Grand Marnier orange liqueur maceration
